# AGL#19 main spec part: banks group (the light collections, included by lib2_agl_19.txt). Per-function lines only (no
# unit-global directives). Receivers are small images of what the collections' own initialize leaves (capacity 3, one
# value per record, record flags as the initializeRecord hooks set them: directed 3, spatial 0xB, paired 1; masks ~0 or
# 0 as setRecordEnabled leaves them) with the record hooks mocked. The producer-built profiles (the light prepass the
# game configures, the ranked-pair recipe, the world shader programs) are the companions lib2_agl_19_banks_*.txt.
src wwhd_src/agl/LightCollectionAccessors.cpp
src wwhd_src/agl/LightCollectionTypes.cpp
src wwhd_src/agl/LightCollectionInitialize.cpp
src wwhd_src/agl/LightCollectionRelease.cpp
src wwhd_src/agl/LightCollectionPasses.cpp
src wwhd_src/agl/LightUniformBinding.cpp
src wwhd_src/sead/RuntimeStatics.cpp
# The images are not written by the mocked record hooks (stable: no clobbering of the image ranges; banks-only addresses).
stable 4C000000 0x30000
stable 4C400000 0x30000
stable 4C800000 0x30000
stable 4D100000 0x2000
stable 4D200000 0x500
stable 4D300000 0x200
